objective: Derive a deterministic, bounded next-best-observation proposal from the verification reason, so a retry asks for a view that could close the gap instead of repeating the same request.
decision_supported: Is retrying the same observation with a fixed budget active perception? No: it can spend every attempt on the same uninformative view.
acceptance: A reason with a gap yields ranked proposals naming the view and the gap.
A view already tried is not proposed again.
A reason with no gap yields an empty list rather than a repeat.
verdict_changed records whether the new sample moved the verdict.
stop_conditions: The change would need an observer signature change.
risks_and_fallbacks: Proposing a view does not guarantee realising it; wiring a viewpoint into ObservationPort is a follow-up the issue keeps out of scope.
